senses.gloss: (Inf. Hif. of רָבָה) to increase; the numerical value of the letters ה̇ר̇ב̇ה̇ = 212 (days).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:6">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> (play on <he>הרבה ארבה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 3:16">Gen. III, 16</cite>) <he>כל שהוא ה׳ ארבה וכ׳</he> if an embryo is 212 days old, I shall cause it to grow (it is vital); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 1:3:7">Y. Nidd. I, 49ᵇ</cite> top <he>כל שהוא בה׳ הרי הוא בארבה</he>; v. <cite ref="A01935"><he>אל״ף</he></cite>.
